findings.first_evidence: scripts/cli-bench/main.go:299: r := collect(fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s/json=%v", count, name, jsonOutput), int64(15*time.Millisecond), func() (int64, int, error) {
findings.suggested_fix: Profile and optimize the snapshot decoding/serialization path, retain every sample, rerun all reference cases before accepting; obtain explicit product decision for any contract change.
findings.title: Reference query latency exceeds the required bound
findings.why_it_matters: The complete 1000-task list/tree reference cases exceed the strict 15ms gate on both Go1.25 and the current compiler; Phase4 cannot be accepted.
findings.validation_reason: All three retained complete reference reports show query latency violations for the required 1000-task fixture; actual incidence measured.

evidence: pflag v1.0.9 int64.go:14: v, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 0, 64)
Plan KTD4: Progress accepts signed base-10 int64 syntax.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a decimal-only pflag.Value with strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64), preserving parse errors before storage and numeric domain validation.
findings.title: Parse progress as decimal rather than automatic radix
findings.why_it_matters: pflag Int64Var uses ParseInt base 0: --progress=010 writes 8 and --progress=0x10 writes 16, violating KTD4 signed base-10 grammar.
findings.validation_reason: pflag v1.0.9 int64 Set parses base0 and edit binds it directly, so zero-prefixed progress is octal; base10 required by KTD4. Reachable ordinary command input.

evidence: scripts/cli-bench/main_test.go fakeProcess emits only id fields, and report tests accept those as correct fixtures.
Feature 004 V89 requires rejection of incorrect byte/data fixtures.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate required fields and representative seeded task/event values, recursively validate tree nodes, and add negatives for same-count empty or malformed objects.
findings.title: Benchmark accepts missing task and event fields
findings.why_it_matters: A process returning arrays of empty objects can satisfy fixture counts and pass the timing report while omitting all task data. The guard must reject incomplete results to avoid accepting a faster but broken serializer.
findings.validation_reason: validateOutput accepts []RawMessage by length without object field checks; same-count empty task/event objects mechanically pass, as fakeProcess report tests demonstrate.
